1.web: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
1.asv: Then Solomon began to build the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem on mount Moriah, whereJehovahappeared unto David his father, which he made ready in the place that David had appointed, in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

2.web: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
2.asv: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

3.web: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house. The length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
3.asv: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

4.web: The porch that was in front, its length, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
4.asv: And the porch that was before the house, the length of it, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height a hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

5.web: The greater house he made a ceiling with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
5.asv: And the greater house he ceiled with fir-wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and wrought thereon palm-trees and chains.

6.web: He garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
6.asv: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

7.web: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and its walls, and its doors, with gold; and engraved cherubim on the walls.
7.asv: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubim on the walls.

8.web: He made the most holy house: its length, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and its breadth twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
8.asv: And he made the most holy house: the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

9.web: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
9.asv: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

10.web: In the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
10.asv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.

11.web: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
11.asv: And the wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

12.web: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
12.asv: And the wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

13.web: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
13.asv: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

14.web: He made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
14.asv: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubim thereon.

15.web: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
15.asv: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

16.web: He made chains in the oracle, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
16.asv: And he made chains in the oracle, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

17.web: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
17.asv: And he set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
